CilExec Java Market release candidate

Runtime requirement: Java 26
Market server requirement: Java 21 or newer
Market protocol: cilexec.market/v1
Built-in client: market.* 2.0.0
Published packages: cilexec/editor/1.0.8

Start the market server from this directory:

java --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED -jar cilexec-market-server.jar --repository repository --catalog catalog.json

The server listens on 127.0.0.1:8787 by default. See MARKET.md for Docker and Windows examples.
